sentences.japanese: 彼女は臆することなく王の面前に出た。
sentences.english: She boldly went up to the king.

sentences.japanese: 彼らに言ひ給ふ『なにゆゑ臆するか、信仰うすき者よ』乃ち起きて、風と海とを禁め給へば、大なる凪となりぬ。
sentences.english: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
